events.issue: First seal reader rejected UTF-8 BOM in the visual review JSON; the subsequent resume invocation verified existing geometry/scoring/render receipts and regenerated summary tables before root seal existed
events.resolution: Use utf-8-sig for JSON readers. Existing per-task receipts prevented every GEO, score and rendering replay; no scientific job repeated. Preserve this bookkeeping error rather than treating it as a new experiment.
